races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict: DOCTOR STEINBERG looked a top-class prospect when demolishing 7 rivals in a Grade 1 novice hurdle last season and, though things did not go to plan afterwards, is likely to prove hard to beat now switched to fences. The highly promising Court Compliance is feared most, while Fort Dino is also respected after an encouraging chase debut. DOCTOR STEINBERG (IRE) COURT COMPLIANCE (IRE) FORT DINO (FR)

races.title: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Chase
races.verdict: IAMAGETAWAY showed improved form to get off the mark over fences at Downpatrick 41 days ago and looks capable of defying an 8 lb rise back in handicap company. Hees Dynamite is well handicapped on his hurdling form and is feared most, while That's About Right and Doctor Confusion are also respected. IAMAGETAWAY (IRE) HEES DYNAMITE (IRE) THAT'S ABOUT RIGHT (IRE)

races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: I DONT REALLY CARE matched her previous best despite finding the test inadequate when third over 2m at Cork 18 days ago and, with the return to this sort of trip looking much more suitable, she looks to hold sound claims. That said, Light Up The Dark is surely capable of better than she showed when second on hurdles debut at Galway last month and better is anticipated up in trip. Dinner Dance is another to note on hurdles bow. I DONT REALLY CARE (IRE) LIGHT UP THE DARK DINNER DANCE (IRE)

races.title: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: COCK AND BULL has progressed on the Flat since last seen over hurdles and will take plenty of beating if transferring that form back to this sphere from a mark that appears to underestimate his true ability. Migdam is feared most after an interesting trainer switch and some help from the handicapper, while Crowsatedappletart and Demanding Gerry look best of the rest. COCK AND BULL (IRE) MIGDAM (FR) CROWSATEDAPPLETART (IRE)

races.title: Racing Again On The 26th November Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: LICEO has knocked firmly at the door since returning from a short break, again finding only one too good over C&D last week and there appears no reason why he won't make a bold bid again from an unchanged mark. Max Meridius shaped well when a place behind the selection that day and can lay down a serious challenge if consenting to race more efficiently, whilst Phoenix Arizona is another worth a look operating from a lower hurdles mark. LICEO (FR) MAX MERIDIUS (IRE) PHOENIX ARIZONA (IRE)

races.title: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com (Q.R.) Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: A thin maiden and in the hope he takes to hurdling at the first attempt, MARHABA GHAIYYATH may well be up to conceding weight all round given his Flat ability. Point recruit Legendary Status is the obvious alternative for Willie Mullins. MARHABA GHAIYYATH (IRE) LEGENDARY STATUS (IRE) QUINLAN (IRE)
